principal_assertion: Pork prohibited under ordinary conditions; selected5:3 directly supports source attribution and contains necessity qualification.
summary_qualification_wording_caveat: English OR and Arabic أو wording awkwardly separate necessity and nontransgression qualifiers. They must not be read as nontransgression alone permitting pork; exact source and limitations retain necessity. Principal ordinary-condition claim is grounded; this is not a personal ruling.
